Synthetic fixtures for mssrscopR (authored; MIT, see the package LICENSE).
Inputs are small deterministic arrays; expected outputs were produced by the research
engine definition mssr_r_rev1 at the parameters in index.csv (rows = y, cols = x;
comma-separated, no header, 17 significant digits). The package engine mssr_r_rev2
differs from rev1 only for degenerate input, which these fixtures do not exercise.
They are regression oracles, not independent ground truth. No research data.
